quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You are advising on a constitutional crisis in which the executive is ignoring the judiciary.
quests.correctAnswer: Clarify the constitutional order through all available legal mechanisms
quests.hint: Every constitutional provision court process and parliamentary procedure that reaffirms judicial authority must be activated.
quests.explanation: Simultaneous activation of multiple legal mechanisms prevents any single mechanism from being circumvented.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You are advising on a constitutional crisis in which the executive is ignoring the judiciary.
quests.correctAnswer: Build broad civil society support for constitutional norms
quests.hint: Engage business civic legal and religious leaders: constitutional crises are not resolved by institutions alone.
quests.explanation: Constitutional norms are ultimately protected by broad social consensus not only by legal mechanisms.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You are advising on a constitutional crisis in which the executive is ignoring the judiciary.
quests.correctAnswer: Engage international legal and diplomatic pressure
quests.hint: Treaty obligations international courts and allied government pressure can reinforce domestic constitutional protections.
quests.explanation: International pressure on constitutional violations creates costs that purely domestic actors cannot impose.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global technology platform is accused of deliberately undermining democratic elections.
quests.correctAnswer: Demand transparent independent audit of algorithmic systems
quests.hint: Require: independent algorithmic audits with full disclosure of manipulation risks.
quests.explanation: Independent algorithmic audits are the most technically credible response to platform election interference concerns.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global technology platform is accused of deliberately undermining democratic elections.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish platform liability for electoral interference
quests.hint: Legal frameworks must establish platform liability for knowingly hosting or amplifying election disinformation.
quests.explanation: Platform liability creates incentives for self-regulation that voluntary compliance frameworks cannot match.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global technology platform is accused of deliberately undermining democratic elections.
quests.correctAnswer: Advance interoperability and competition to reduce single-platform power
quests.hint: Requiring platforms to be interoperable with competitors reduces the concentration of digital influence.
quests.explanation: Structural market remedies address the root cause of platform election power more sustainably than conduct rules.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Climate change is creating conflict between developed and developing nations over emissions targets.
quests.correctAnswer: Negotiate differentiated but binding commitments
quests.hint: Frameworks must recognise historical emissions responsibility while binding all parties to ambitious future targets.
quests.explanation: Differentiated but binding commitments are the only framework that developing nations will sign and developed nations cannot avoid.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Climate change is creating conflict between developed and developing nations over emissions targets.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish a substantial and credible climate finance mechanism
quests.hint: Developed nations must deliver concrete climate finance — not as aid but as compensation for historical emissions.
quests.explanation: Framing climate finance as compensation rather than charity shifts the political economy of climate negotiations.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Climate change is creating conflict between developed and developing nations over emissions targets.
quests.correctAnswer: Create technology transfer mechanisms as part of climate agreements
quests.hint: Climate agreements must include binding commitments to transfer clean technology not just financial contributions.
quests.explanation: Technology transfer alongside finance enables developing nations to grow without repeating developed nations' emissions path.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A nuclear-armed state is threatening military action over a territorial dispute.
quests.correctAnswer: Open multiple diplomatic back-channels simultaneously
quests.hint: Formal and informal channels must operate in parallel — formal for record informal for genuine exploration of off-ramps.
quests.explanation: Parallel formal and informal channels maximise the options for de-escalation in nuclear crisis diplomacy.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A nuclear-armed state is threatening military action over a territorial dispute.
quests.correctAnswer: Avoid public ultimatums that remove room for face-saving retreat
quests.hint: Public ultimatums lock both parties in — private communications allow positions to shift without public humiliation.
quests.explanation: Face-saving exit routes are as important in nuclear diplomacy as the substantive resolution itself.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A nuclear-armed state is threatening military action over a territorial dispute.
quests.correctAnswer: Engage the UN Security Council and allied powers as co-mediators
quests.hint: Multilateral mediation distributes the diplomatic burden and reduces the bilateral power of the threatening state.
quests.explanation: Multilateral crisis management prevents bilateral crises from becoming contests of prestige.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An autonomous weapons system has caused civilian casualties in a conflict zone.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish an independent investigation with international representation
quests.hint: Any investigation must include parties beyond the deploying nation to be credible internationally.
quests.explanation: International representation in autonomous weapons investigations prevents self-serving findings that escalate conflict.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An autonomous weapons system has caused civilian casualties in a conflict zone.
quests.correctAnswer: Suspend the system pending a full accountability review
quests.hint: Immediate suspension signals both accountability intent and recognition that the human cost cannot be normalised.
quests.explanation: Suspending autonomous weapons systems after civilian harm is essential before any review is seen as credible.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An autonomous weapons system has caused civilian casualties in a conflict zone.
quests.correctAnswer: Use the incident to advance international autonomous weapons regulation
quests.hint: Real incidents create the political will for legal frameworks. Use this moment to advance treaty discussions.
quests.explanation: Tragic incidents with autonomous weapons can catalyse the international regulatory frameworks that prevention alone cannot achieve.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major pandemic is causing conflict between national sovereignty and global health governance.
quests.correctAnswer: Strengthen WHO emergency powers with accountability mechanisms
quests.hint: WHO authority to declare emergencies needs binding national compliance but with transparent accountable governance.
quests.explanation: Binding emergency authority with accountability mechanisms addresses both global effectiveness and national sovereignty concerns.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major pandemic is causing conflict between national sovereignty and global health governance.
quests.correctAnswer: Build pre-committed resource sharing mechanisms
quests.hint: Nations should pre-commit outside of crisis to share vaccines treatments and health workers in emergencies.
quests.explanation: Pre-committed agreements made outside crisis conditions are more reliable than commitments made under pressure.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major pandemic is causing conflict between national sovereignty and global health governance.
quests.correctAnswer: Develop equitable global manufacturing infrastructure for critical medicines
quests.hint: Regional manufacturing capacity that covers all parts of the world removes the geopolitics of pharmaceutical supply.
quests.explanation: Distributed equitable manufacturing capacity is the most structurally sound solution to medical access inequality.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A post-conflict society must reconcile communities that committed atrocities against each other.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish a truth and reconciliation process with broad participation
quests.hint: Reconciliation requires a structured process for testimony acknowledgment and recorded truth — not immediate forgiveness.
quests.explanation: Truth comes before reconciliation — societies cannot reconcile what they cannot honestly acknowledge.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A post-conflict society must reconcile communities that committed atrocities against each other.
quests.correctAnswer: Design transitional justice that balances accountability and peace
quests.hint: Pure impunity prevents reconciliation. Pure punishment prevents peace. Transitional justice navigates both imperatives.
quests.explanation: Transitional justice mechanisms must serve both accountability and future social cohesion simultaneously.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A post-conflict society must reconcile communities that committed atrocities against each other.
quests.correctAnswer: Build economic interdependence between previously conflicting communities
quests.hint: Economic programmes that require co-operation between former enemies create practical incentives for sustained peace.
quests.explanation: Economic interdependence creates structural incentives for peace that political agreements alone cannot sustain.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Artificial general intelligence development is creating conflict between nations competing for dominance.
quests.correctAnswer: Propose an international AI safety treaty with verification mechanisms
quests.hint: AGI development requires a treaty analogous to nuclear non-proliferation — with genuine verification not self-reporting.
quests.explanation: Verifiable international AI safety agreements are the only mechanism that can prevent a destabilising race to AGI.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Artificial general intelligence development is creating conflict between nations competing for dominance.
quests.correctAnswer: Create shared international safety research institutions
quests.hint: Jointly funded AI safety labs that publish findings benefit all parties and reduce the advantage of secrecy.
quests.explanation: Shared international safety research institutions reduce the arms-race dynamic in AGI development.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Artificial general intelligence development is creating conflict between nations competing for dominance.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish graduated safeguards at each capability threshold
quests.hint: International standards should trigger increasing oversight as AI systems approach new capability thresholds.
quests.explanation: Graduated safeguard frameworks are more achievable and more adaptable than single bright-line AGI restrictions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Mass migration triggered by climate change is creating severe geopolitical conflict.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish a new international legal category for climate refugees
quests.hint: Current refugee law does not cover climate displacement. A new legal category creates protection rights and responsibilities.
quests.explanation: Legal recognition of climate refugee status is the prerequisite for creating appropriate protection frameworks.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Mass migration triggered by climate change is creating severe geopolitical conflict.
quests.correctAnswer: Create burden-sharing agreements before crises become acute
quests.hint: Countries most responsible for climate change and most capable of absorbing migration must make binding commitments.
quests.explanation: Pre-committed burden-sharing agreements prevent the nationalist bidding wars that occur during acute migration crises.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Mass migration triggered by climate change is creating severe geopolitical conflict.
quests.correctAnswer: Fund migration-reducing climate adaptation in vulnerable nations
quests.hint: Investing in climate resilience in vulnerable countries reduces migration pressure more sustainably than border enforcement.
quests.explanation: Upstream investment in climate adaptation reduces migration at source more sustainably than downstream reception management.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Disinformation spread by state actors is undermining democratic institutions globally.
quests.correctAnswer: Build a cross-national rapid response network for disinformation
quests.hint: Democratic governments must share intelligence on state disinformation campaigns in near-real-time.
quests.explanation: Speed of counter-response to state disinformation campaigns determines whether they achieve their destabilising goals.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Disinformation spread by state actors is undermining democratic institutions globally.
quests.correctAnswer: Invest in civic media literacy at population scale
quests.hint: Broad-based education in recognising disinformation is a resilience measure that no platform rule can replace.
quests.explanation: Population-scale media literacy creates distributed resilience against disinformation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Disinformation spread by state actors is undermining democratic institutions globally.
quests.correctAnswer: Impose meaningful costs on states that sponsor disinformation
quests.hint: Economic diplomatic and cyber-retaliation costs deter state-sponsored disinformation more effectively than defensive measures.
quests.explanation: Deterrence — imposing credible costs — is often more effective than defence alone against state-sponsored information warfare.
